entities.name: Élodie Godin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Élodie Godin is a French former basketball player. She was a member of the French national team, winning the 2009 Eurobasket and a silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics and playing the 2006 and 2010 World Championships.
